edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Hom. in Cant. I, 9

source_text: Post haec verba sponsus ei comminatur et dicit: aut cognosces temet ipsam quoniam regis es sponsa et formosa et a me facta formosa — ego siquidem exhibui mihi gloriosam ecclesiam non habentem maculam neque rugam —; aut scito quia, si te non cognoveris et tuam nescieris dignitatem, patieris haec quae sequuntur. Si non cognoveris temet ipsam, o pulchra in mulieribus, egredere tu in vestigiis gregum, et pasce haedos tuos. Statuet quippe oves a dextris et a sinistris haedos. Si non cognoveris temet ipsam, o pulchra in mulieribus, egredere tu in vestigiis gregum, et pasce haedos tuos in tabernaculis pastorum. In vestigiis inquit pastorum novissima fies, non inter oves, sed inter haedos tuos, cum quibus habitans non poteris mecum, id est cum bono esse pastore.
pass_a_gloss: After these words bridegroom threatens: either you-will-know yourself that of-king you-are bride and beautiful and by-me made beautiful — I presented glorious church without spot/wrinkle — or if you-do-not know yourself/dignity you-will-suffer what follows. If you-do-not know yourself, O beautiful among women, go-out in tracks of-flocks and pasture your goats (sheep right / goats left). On shepherds' tracks you-will-be last — not among sheep but goats — and dwelling with them cannot be with me the good shepherd.
notes: Pass A literalist gloss ≠ Pass B literary English.
Song lemma sense-checked against Baehrens; Lawson ACW not used for wording.

bible_links.why: if you do not know yourself

pass_b_english: After these words the Bridegroom threatens her and says: either you will know yourself, that you are a king’s bride and beautiful and made beautiful by me — for I have presented to myself a glorious Church [[not having spot or wrinkle >> Bible:Ephesians 5:27]] — or know that if you do not know yourself and do not know your dignity, you will suffer what follows. [[If you do not know yourself, O beautiful among women >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:8]], go out upon the tracks of the flocks, and pasture your goats. For he will set the [[sheep on the right and the goats on the left >> Bible:Matthew 25:33]]. If you do not know yourself, O beautiful among women, go out upon the tracks of the flocks, and pasture your goats in the shepherds’ tents. On the shepherds’ tracks, he says, you will be last — not among the sheep, but among your goats; and dwelling with them you will not be able to be with me, that is, with the good shepherd.
